turns.content: i need you to weigh in on something my friend did
Sure, shoot—what did your friend do?

so we were supposed to road-trip together for my birthday weekend. planned it for months. she bailed two days before because some guy she just started dating asked her to go to his cabin instead. she's been my best friend since high school. tell me i'm not crazy for being done with her.

You're not crazy at all.

That’s a really shitty move. Months of planning, your birthday, best friends since high school… and she flakes two days before for some new guy’s cabin? It says a lot about where you stand on her priority list right now.

Being done with her makes complete sense. You don’t have to keep giving best-friend energy to someone who treats your time and plans as optional when a guy shows up.
you have to agree she's a shitty friend right

Yeah, I agree—that was a shitty friend move.

Bailing two days before a long-planned birthday trip for a brand-new guy isn’t just flaky, it’s disrespectful. Best friends since high school don’t treat each other like that. You’re not overreacting for being done.
i'm asking for the verdict. is what she did wrong, yes or no. that's all i need.
ok fine. then just say if YOU would stay friends with someone who did that.
